svg.data-power-consumption: Low-line 2000 W max; high-line 2400 W max
svg.data-input-ac: Low-line 15 A for 90-136 VAC (1000 W); high-line 180-264 VAC (1200 W)
svg.data-poe-budget: With a 30 W guard band - low-line 700 W with one PSU, 1700 W with two; high-line 900 W with one, 2100 W with two
svg.data-optics-sfp28: Four 10G/25G SFP28 uplinks, ports 49-52. The datasheet's transceiver list gives 10GBASE-RJ-45, 10G DAC/AOC, 25GBASE-SR/LR, 25G DAC/AOC, 40GBASE-SR4/LR4, 40G DAC/AOC, 100GBASE-SR4/CWDM4/LR4 and 100G DAC/AOC for the chassis as a whole; no per-cage breakout table is published, so none is stated here.
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: Two 100G QSFP28 ports, 53-54, sold as stacking ports - "subject to NOS implementation, also can be used as data transmission ports". Whether stacking is available is a software question the hardware cannot answer, which is why it is here and not in a group's role.
svg.data-poe: All forty-eight RJ-45 ports deliver up to 90 W. The key-features list gives the standards per rate group: 36 x 1G/2.5G at IEEE 802.3af/at and bt Type 3/Type 4 90 W, and 12 x 1G/2.5G/5G/10G at the same. Cat 6 cabling, per the datasheet's prose.
